title: Sr SRE Engineer
description:
**Experience Required:**
6\-8 years of SRE or infrastructure engineering experience in cloud\-native environments. **Mandatory:*** Cloud: GCP (GKE, Load Balancing, VPN, IAM)
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog
* Containers \& Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker
* Incident Management: On\-call, RCA, SLIs/SLOs
* IaC: Terraform, Helm
* Incident Tools: PagerDuty, OpsGenie

 **Nice to Have**:* GCP Monitoring, Skywalking
* Service Mesh, API Gateway
* GCP Spanner, MongoDB (basic)

 **Scope:*** Drive operational excellence and platform resilience
* Reduce MTTR, increase service availability
* Own incident and RCA processes

 **Roles and Responsibilities:*** Define and measure Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and manage error budgets across services.
* Lead incident management for critical production issues – drive root cause analysis (RCA) and postmortems.
* Create and maintain runbooks and standard operating procedures for high availability services.
* Design and implement observability frameworks using ELK, Prometheus, and Grafana; drive telemetry adoption.
* Coordinate cross\-functional war\-room sessions during major incidents and maintain response logs.
* Develop and improve automated system recovery, alert suppression, and escalation logic.
* Use GCP tools like GKE, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Armor to improve performance and security posture.
* Collaborate with DevOps and Infrastructure teams to build highly available and scalable systems.
* Analyze performance metrics and conduct regular reliability reviews with engineering leads.
* Participate in capacity planning, failover testing, and resilience architecture reviews.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
This role requires close collaboration with development, QA, and security teams to ensure high availability, performance, and security of the platform.


  
* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable automated build, testing, and deployment using tools such as Jenkins and Azure DevOps.
* Manage, provision, and optimize Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud infrastructure in to ensure scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation to automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
* Build, deploy, and manage containerized applications using Docker and Amazon ECS to support scalable and portable application environments.
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using tools such as Dynatrace and Splunk to ensure system health, observability, and rapid incident response.
* Develop automation scripts using Python and CDKTF to streamline infrastructure management and operational tasks.
* Ensure high availability, performance, and system reliability through proactive monitoring, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Integrate DevSecOps best practices by implementing security and compliance checks within CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Wiz.
* Collaborate with development, QA, and operations teams to enhance development workflows, streamline deployments, and improve overall release efficiency.
* Provide production support by troubleshooting system issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing corrective and preventive measures to ensure platform stability. Participation in a scheduled on\-call rotation may be required.

  
* 5–7 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Engineering roles.
* Cloud Platforms: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
* CI/CD \& DevOps Tools: Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, GitHub, CI/CD Pipeline Design, Release Automation
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, CDKTF
* Containerization \& Orchestration: Docker, Amazon ECS
* Monitoring \& Observability: Dynatrace, Splunk, Application Monitoring, Logging, Alerting
* Programming \& Scripting: Python, Typescript, Shell/Bash Scripting, PowerShell
* DevSecOps \& Security: Wiz, Security Scanning, Compliance Automation, Secure CI/CD Practices
* Cloud \& Infrastructure Management: Cloud Infrastructure Provisioning, High Availability Architecture, Performance Optimization, Cost Optimization

**Soft Skills**  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex production issues efficiently.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Certification such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional or Certified Kubernetes Administrator.
* Prior experience working in high\-scale SaaS or product\-based environments.
